notes.title: Galactic Chef is now FlavorSpace
notes.notes:
This is a major update with improvements to nearly every aspect of the game, however there are likely to be game-breaking bugs!

[b]Some highlights:[/b]

 • Renamed the game to avoid a potential trademark issue.
 • Added Chef Shop so you can choose which tools and ingredients you want to unlock.
 • Added "Quantum Separator" tool.
 • Gravi-tongs now show an outline to make it clearer what they will grab.
 • Flipper can now easily gather and carry multiple pieces of food.
 • Redesigned Particulator, now homogenizes food.
 • Improved Food Vacuum now shows fill progress, and layers particles according to the order in which they were vacuumed. 
 • Liquids can finally resolidify, i.e. when something melts and then cools back down.
 • Most liquid-related mechanics have been reworked including washing, dissolving, juicing, melting, reducing, and even how liquids are rendered. 
 • All ingredients have been updated with new properties.
 • Pantry and Recipe Planner now show ingredient ambition score and category.
 • Completely revamped judging and scoring to enable new kinds of criteria.
 • Changed some challenges.
 • Numerous bugfixes
 
[b]Known issues[/b]

 • NPCs perform terribly; this will be fixed in the next update.
 • Judges don't currently score the ambition of your dish; it's too easy to win with simple dishes. This will be fixed in the next update.
 • Many ingredients behave unrealistically and will be improved in the next update.
 • Hidden judge preferences have been temporarily removed.
 • Music will likely get repetitive; more tracks are coming in the next update.
 • Heat exchange still needs work. 
 • There may be an issue with music volume adjustment.
 • At least one bug in the Recipe Planner may cause incorrect simulations.
 • Mice with high polling rates (i.e. some gaming mice) sometimes cause significant framerate drops. Rebooting your computer may fix the issue, but the cause is still not fully understood.

notes.title: Galactic Chef Alpha 082: A few new challenges, bugfixes
notes.notes:
This is a relatively minor update:

 • Cmokemvfl Contest has been replaced with a three-part "Chef's Gauntlet".
 • The Galactic Chef pilot episode is back (Cmokemvfl is one of the challenges.)
 • Fixed a bug that would prevent loading a career if your last autosave occurred during a losing cutscene for a challenge you previously won.
 • Various other bugfixes.

notes.title: Galactic Chef Alpha 0.81
notes.notes:
This update is focused on making the first challenges in the game make more sense.

 • The sandwich challenges now have more realistic judging criteria.
 • The tutorials have been rearranged and altered to fit within the first two contests and clarify some things.
 • Some ingredients have been updated for more realistic behaviors.
 • Fixed several bugs in the Recipe Planner.
 • Unlockable items are now available only in the challenge that introduces them, until you win that challenge. Then they become available everywhere.
 • Other minor tweaks and bugfixes.
 
[b]Known issues:[/b]

 • Using the squeeze bottle in the serving area may cause dishes to be ejected.
 • Some ingredients still don't behave how they should.
 • Liquid behaviors such as re-solidifying are not fully implemented yet.
 • At least one bug in the Recipe Planner may cause incorrect simulations.

notes.title: Galactic Chef Experimental Playtest Alpha 080
notes.notes:
It's been a long time! This is an experimental update to get early feedback on numerous changes to the game's systems, although the changes might not be immediately obvious. If you're looking for a smooth/polished experience, you may want to wait for the next update, but any feedback on this version would be appreciated!

Some highlights:

 • The cooking simulation has been redesigned for more realistic liquids and better cooking gameplay.
 • Each tutorial is now followed by an un-guided challenge. 
 • Ingredient selection has been moved to a "pantry phase" after challenge introduction where applicable.
 • The Food Vacuum now collects food and ejects it when full, instead of simply destroying it.
 • The Flipper can now lift and carry food in addition to flipping it.
 • Grabbing near the edge of a container (dish or cookware) now always grabs the container, instead of sometimes lifting food from the container.
 • The Recipe Planner has been revamped for greater flexibility.
 • Judging and scoring have been improved.
 • Many other changes were made behind the scenes to prepare for future additions.
 • The Galactic Chef "pilot episode" has been temporarily removed, and will be added back in another update soon.

Known issues:

 • Saved games from older versions are no longer compatible.
 • Liquid behaviors such as re-solidifying are not fully implemented yet.
 • Judges are currently too forgiving.
 • At least one bug in the Recipe Planner may cause incorrect simulations.

notes.title: Galactic Chef 0.74
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]Sauces can now be dispensed anywhere, not just onto existing foods. 
[*]Dishes, ingredients, and cookware now fully exist before pulling them off the rack.
[*]Removed auto-centering of food in dishes and cookware, so you can compose your dishes more freely.
[*]Added option to disable VSync as a workarouund for a bug related to mice with high polling rates.
[*]Fixed a crash when tastelizing the garbage disposal.
[/list]

notes.title: Galactic Chef Bugfix Update 0.71
notes.notes: This is just a quick fix for a few bugs. More bugfixes are likely coming soon.

notes.title: Alpha 070: The Road to Galactic Chef
notes.notes:
For the past 10 months I've been rebuilding almost every part of Galactic Chef, working toward a new vision. The main experience is now focused on hand-crafted challenges, ingredients, and better progression. Procedurally generated parallel universes will return in a future update, but for now I need your help to make sure I'm on the right track with the first few challenges.

Expect bugs, but please report them!

Some of the main changes include:
[list]
[*]Revamped ingredient behaviors and simulation
[*]Redesigned tastelizer and recipe planner
[*]The pipette has been replaced with a squeeze bottle, allowing for finer control and dispensing sauces
[*]The hammer no-longer merges food objects
[*]New "career" system allows separate progress for multiple players
[*]Contests now take place on different worlds with new art and cutscenes
[*]Judges now have hidden preferences to discover over time
[*]Currently only 5 hand-crafted challenges are available
[/list]

Again, your feedback is crucial to making the game better! Please share any feedback either on the Community Hub, or on the Thoughtquake Discord server:
https://discord.gg/9kSsnaC

notes.title: Galactic Chef 0.61: Clearer text update
notes.notes:
This is a minor update:

* Increased text clarity
* Plates on the main menu no-longer spin
* Fixed a bug that completely broke Creative Mode

notes.title: Galactic Chef 0.60: Introducing the Recipe Planner
notes.notes:
This is a major update introducing the Recipe Planner and other new features.

* Recipe Planner allows you to see full ingredient stats, simulate changes, review challenge criteria, and build a recipe - all on one screen!
* RecipePad is a smaller replacement for the DataPad that fits better in the kitchen so it can always be visible
* Added animations to host and judges
* Added difficulty options
* Added soup bowls
* All challenges are now 10 minutes long
* Increased portion size target for normal dishes
* Temporarily removed judge preferences
* Many smaller improvements and bugfixes

notes.title: Bugfix Update - Galactic Chef 0.51
notes.notes: Big updates mean lots of opportunities for bugs to slip through. This fixes a few critical issues, and more patches are likely to come soon as playtest feedback starts coming in.

notes.title: Major Galactic Chef Update! Version 0.50
notes.notes:
This is a major update with changes to UI, tools, ingredient generation, scoring and more.

Interface and Tools

* DataPad replaces the Notebook, with a new navigation system and detailed information on cooking techniques
* Hazard scanner replaces the laserboard magnifier, making it easier to locate and remove poisonous pits
* Gravi-Tongs can now pull nearby objects closer for easier grabbing
* Added Food Vacuum for easier disposal of unwanted scraps
* Knobs and tastelizer can now be dragged with any tool
* Removed "Pointer" tool and bandbox selection
* Tool hotkeys now correspond to their name rather than position on the toolbar
* Pipette can now discard liquids in the sink
* Improved look and behavior of in-kitchen buttons and tooltips

Simulation and Scoring

* Revised ingredient generation
* Judge preferences now have less impact on score
* More realistic boiling
* More realistic liquid merging
* Removed "gas" and "gritty" textures
* Added "stringy" and "rubbery" textures

Miscellaneous

* Five new ingredient templates
* Reduced repetitive cutscenes so the important ones are more noticeable
* Various bugfixes, tweaks, and polish

Known issues

 * Saved games from older versions will not load correctly but may still be playable
 * Ingredient simulation is still incomplete and will be updated soon

notes.title: Galactic Chef Alpha 0.46
notes.notes:
- NPC competitors now start off weaker and improve over time for a better difficulty curve
 - Fixed Discord link on feedback pane
 - Fixed Globulator slider not being hidden before Globulator is unlocked
 - Switched from debug to release build, which should significantly improve performance

Bigger changes are coming soon to better address the difficulty curve, ambiguity about certain mechanics, and more!

notes.title: Galactic Chef 0.45: Another bugfixing and polish update
notes.notes:
- Grav hammer splatters now look more natural
 - Bandbox-selecting small pieces of food now works better
 - Added "a Note from the Dev" to the main menu
 - Minor bugfixes and tweaks

notes.title: Galactic Chef 0.44 Fixed Upload
notes.notes: Sorry for the excessive updates! Something went wrong last-minute with the Linux build that completely broke the game, but this update should fix it. Nothing else is changed.

notes.title: Galactic Chef Hotfix Update 0.44
notes.notes:
This update fixes some game-breaking bugs:

 - Fixed: Missing lock icon on Globulator before unlocking it
 - Fixed: Sometimes liquids would be judged as another texture
 - Fixed: Laserboard didn't cut foods at all if they were partially outside the cutting area
 - Fixed: Crash when announcing the results of the final challenge
 - Added option to reset profile

Known issues (not new in this build):
 - Loading saves from older versions may crash
 - Liquid and gas simulation is still incomplete, and will be improved soon

notes.title: Galactic Chef 0.43
notes.notes:
This is mostly a bugfixing and polish update.

 - The tutorial is now much more resilient to doing things out of order
 - The pilot episode now uses a pre-determined set of challenges with new informative introductions
 - The tastelizer probe is now draggable from anywhere
 - A more standard mouse pointer is now used in menus and some other UI, and a crosshair is used on the laserboard magnifier
 - The standard mouse pointer is also selectable as a tool in the kitchen, and this is now the only way to group-select multiple objects
 - You can now keep the system mouse pointer visible if preferred (see options menu)
 - LOTS of bugfixes

notes.title: Galactic Chef 0.42: Game-changing UI redesign!
notes.notes:
This update brings a fundamental change to how you play the game - your mouse pointer now becomes the selected tool, so you don't have to drag tools around anymore. There are a lot of other changes here too:

 - Major UI and kitchen layout changes
 - Updated and improved tutorial
 - New "Pilot Episode" mode with just 4 contestants and 3 challenges
 - Full seasons, the blander, and the globulator are now unlocked when you win the pilot episode (or if you won a full season previously)
 - If you previously unlocked the globulator, your unlock credit should be reset
 - Each season now has only 12 ingredients so you can see them all at once
 - Added "Credits" panel
 - Fixed: Hovering over texture icons to identify them sometimes didn't work
 - Fixed: Loading a save didn't restore the correct challenge sequence
 - Many other tweaks and bugfixes

Known issues:
 - Liquid and gas simulation is incomplete, and will be improved soon.

Many thanks to the playtesters whose feedback has helped shape this game for the better. Please continue to let me know what I can improve!

notes.title: Galactic Chef 0.41 - Soundtrack Update!
notes.notes: This build adds a first draft of the soundtrack, with 9 pieces of original music. There are no gameplay changes in this build, but any feedback on the soundtrack and/or bug reports would be appreciated!

notes.title: Galactic Chef Tutorial Update with Big Changes! (v0.40)
notes.notes:
What's new in Version 0.40?

This is a major update focused mainly on a new tutorial experience and polishing gameplay systems. Judging criteria have changed! Expect bugs, but please report them.

 - New introduction and tutorial experience
 - Judge preferences and major scoring changes
 - New notebook features including filtering ingredients by flavor
 - Creative mode
 - Numerous bugfixes and smaller improvements

Known issues:
 - Sometimes mousing over a texture icon does not show the texture name
 - There is still no music, but that is the next priority after bug fixing!
 - Liquid and gas simulation is incomplete, and will be improved soon.

notes.title: Minor Update v0.35
notes.notes: This fixes a missing background image for the unlocks screen, but also removes the feedback form. Online privacy laws are complicated, and I want to make sure I'm fully compliant if I'm going to collect feedback or any other data. The form may or may not be added back in the future, but feedback is always appreciated through other channels including the Steam Community Hub.

notes.title: Minor Update v0.34
notes.notes:
This is just a quick update to address a few things:

 - Added Feedback form
 - Changed heat reaction icons to be more colorblind friendly
 - Removed "Blue" challenge because it's unfair to colorblind players
 - Minor bugfixes

More and bigger updates will be coming in the next few weeks!
